data.name: Groom's shirts in China (buy with the suit, two of them)
data.notes: Buy the same day as the suits so the jacket sleeves are altered to show 1 to 1.5 cm of cuff. Made-to-measure shirts usually take 3 to 7 days in China and fit within the trip. Tuxedo: white shirt with French cuffs, cut for a bow tie. Navy suit: plain white cotton two-ply shirt.

data.name: Buy wedding shoes (Louboutin) before the China trip
data.notes: Bring both pairs to every dress and suit fitting: hem and trouser length depend on heel height. Buy in the US, usually cheaper than in China. Get clear heel protectors for the lawn ceremony and the gravel path, and a lower pair for dancing and the table toasts.

data.name: Back lawn ceremony: gravel path and seating for elderly guests
data.notes: The ceremony is on the back lawn facing the Sound. Ask about a mat or runner on the gravel path from the house, keep the front rows nearest the house for elders, and assign escorts. Also ask if the second-floor rooms have AC.

data.name: Outfit change plan: 15 minutes or less, during a course
data.notes: Chinese couples' top regret: guests leaving during a long change. A May 2026 change took 46 minutes and the table toasts were cancelled. Have the MC announce it.

data.name: EVUS for relatives with 10-year visas
data.notes: Required before each trip. About $30.

data.name: Visa prep in person: mock interviews and a document folder
data.notes: Practice in Mandarin: purpose, dates, who pays, ties to China. Folder: hukou, property deed, pension or bank statements, retirement papers, old passports, the wedding invitation, your status papers.

data.name: Tea ceremony: one coordinator and a printed order of elders
data.notes: Couples report it runs 15 minutes with parents only and up to 2 hours with 50 relatives. Pour before people sit, fill cups a third, one person collects envelopes.

data.name: Relatives in China: start visa forms and book interviews now
data.notes: Don't wait for November. Interview waits (Oct 2026): Beijing ~4.5 months, Shanghai ~3.5, Guangzhou ~2, Shenyang ~0.5. Since Sep 2025 people over 79 must interview too. DS-160 and booking (usvisascheduling.com) are online. Aim for Dec to Feb interviews.

data.name: Visitor medical insurance for elderly relatives
data.notes: Must cover acute onset of pre-existing conditions. Chinese domestic plans don't cover the US.

data.name: Agree with both families who keeps the red envelope money
data.notes: Decided Oct 7, 2026: all gift money goes to Johnny and Irene. No disagreement between the families.

data.name: Decide whether to hold a thank-you banquet in China
data.notes: For relatives who can't travel. Usually shows the US wedding video.

data.name: Ask Philip Stone for a Chinese station or course for the elders
data.notes: Couples report elders raised on banquets find plated Western dinners too small. The Peking duck station is already picked. The contract includes 2 stations, so the cost of extras is asked in the Emily email.

data.name: Recheck US customs and tariff rules before flying home
data.notes: Rules changed in Feb, Jul and Aug 2026. Check cbp.gov.

data.name: Optional: pre-wedding photo shoot in Suzhou
data.notes: Photos could also be used on the save-the-dates and the website.

data.name: Check US import duties and luggage limits for bringing orders home
data.notes: Carry, don't ship. In luggage: one joint declaration gives the two of you $1,600 duty-free, the next $1,000 is 3%, and the 12.5% China tariff doesn't apply to personal baggage. Shipped later: full duty plus 12.5%. Declare all food including tea (no citrus/chenpi tea). Bring a printed invitation to explain bulk items. Bags max 23 kg each.

data.name: Wedding dress in Suzhou (Huqiu wedding dress district)
data.notes: Main: white full A-line ball gown. Second: a smaller A-line or mermaid, only if just as forgiving. Couture level, no cheap basic dresses. Full custom from a photo takes 1 to 1.5 months, so buy a sample or stock dress and have it altered there. Top complaint (614 cases in 2023): the dress delivered isn't the one tried on. Deposit only, pay the rest after the final try-on, film yourself in it, carry it home, never have it posted. Ask them to leave seam allowance for US alterations. Weekday visit; check shops on Dianping/Xiaohongshu first; ask about try-on fees.
